//: IMPORT TEMPLATE — metadata and placeholders ONLY.
READ THIS BEFORE USING THE FILE.
1. This template contains NO religious text and none may be added to it
in this repository. The `text` / `title` fields below are deliberate
placeholders. Fill them in your own working copy against the official
printed/published source, then import — do not commit the filled file.
2. Nothing here is pre-approved. An entry becomes citable by the
assistant only after a human has matched it, word for word, against an
official published source and recorded that fact in the provenance
fields. Copying a passage from memory, from a website of unknown
provenance, or from a model is not verification.
3. Existing `supplications` records are ordinary content records with no
provenance. They stay unverified — and therefore uncitable — until
each one is individually matched against an official source. There is
no bulk 'mark everything verified' path, by design.
4. The `authority` value must name the body that actually published the
edition you checked, and `sourceUrl` must be the HTTPS link to that
published edition. Do not enter a ministry or council name unless you
are holding its publication.
Import with:  node scripts/ingest_knowledge.mjs <your-filled-file>.json
See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md → 'Source registry' for the full field contract.
